descriptionChirho: The proper name Simeon/Shimon, referring primarily to the second son of Jacob and Leah and the Israelite tribe descended from him, as well as other individuals bearing this name. All four clusters are grammatical variants (bare noun, with conjunction, with preposition) of the same name. Spanish Simeon/Shimon, Arabic Shimoun, Hindi Shimon, Korean simeon/simeon, Swahili Simeoni. Every target language consistently uses a single transliteration across all clusters, confirming one unified proper-name sense.
